author: PRANTIK PRABAL ROY
description: Cooper Kupp’s NFC Championship appearance against his former Rams blended football and family into one powerful moment. Now with the Seahawks, the Super Bowl MVP faced his past while drawing strength from his wife Anna and their three sons. The matchup symbolized resilience, loyalty, and a fresh chapter driven by purpose.
title: Cooper Kupp’s wife draws reaction in Seahawks coat

author: NITASHA NATU
description: In a remarkable display of technology's capability, facial recognition played a crucial role in the swift arrest of a suspect linked to the tragic murder of a college teacher in Mumbai. Just 12 hours post-incident at Malad station, authorities successfully identified and apprehended Omkar Shinde. The suspect reportedly attacked the victim following a minor disagreement onboard a local train.
title: Murder in Mumbai local: How cameras with facial tech traced teacher’s killer in 12 hours

author: TNN
description: The Padma Awards 2024 celebrated a remarkable 131 honorees, including icons like Dharmendra and the late V S Achuthanandhan, alongside sports stars Rohit Sharma and Harmanpreet Kaur, and cinematic legend Mammootty. This year's recognition extends to the unsung heroes from various fields and remote areas, with 10 districts making their award debut.
title: Padma awards 2026 for Dharmendra, Shibu Soren, cricketers Harmanpreet Kaur, Rohit Sharma

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Donald Trump urged all Democratic governors and mayors to cooperate with his administration on immigration enforcement, blaming Joe Biden for a surge in illegal immigration and rising violence. He specifically called on Minnesota's Governor Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Frey to assist in deporting "criminal illegal aliens" and demanded an end to "sanctuary cities."
title: 'Cooperate, turn over all illegal aliens': Trump's targets Walz amid immigration crackdown

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Shaadi.com founder Anupam Mittal advocates for founders stepping down as CEOs, calling it maturity, not failure. He argues that startups outgrow founders' management skills, necessitating professional leadership for sustained growth.  Globally accepted, this transition is often misconstrued in India as a sign of defeat, Mittal noted.
title: Founder exit, not failure: Shark Tank India judge Anupam Mittal explains why

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: India is set to significantly slash import duties on European cars, potentially to 40% from over 100%, as a free trade agreement with the EU nears conclusion. This move opens India's auto market, benefiting European brands like BMW and Volkswagen, while protecting domestic electric vehicle production initially. The deal aims to boost trade and diversify supply chains.
title: India–EU FTA: New Delhi likely to cut car import tariffs from 110% to 40% - report

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Tech giants Microsoft and Amazon, usually fierce rivals, have joined forces to tackle Washington State's severe housing crisis.  The companies jointly penned an op-ed, pledging $1.6 billion to build over 26,000 affordable homes for the community. They urge policymakers to prioritize policies that simplify and expedite construction, warning that inaction risks further economic decline and talent loss.
title: Microsoft and Amazon take out full-page ad, warn Washington faces ‘emergency’

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Canada's prime minister Mark Carney denies plans for a free trade deal with China. This comes after US President Donald Trump threatened tariffs on Canadian goods. Carney affirmed Canada's commitment to the CUSMA agreement, which restricts such deals with non-market economies without prior notice. Carney said recent engagements with China focused on resolving existing tariff disputes, not broader trade pacts.
title: ‘No intention’: Carney rules out free trade pact with China after Trump threatens tariffs

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Sunrisers Eastern Cape pulled off a sensational last-over heist to beat Pretoria Capitals by six wickets and win the fourth edition of the SA20. It was their third title, having also finished runners-up last year. From the auction to structure, SEC are, undoubtedly, T20 franchise cricket's sporting dynasty.
title: SA20: What makes Sunrisers a sporting dynasty - 'A well-balanced team'

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Abhishek Sharma smashed the second-fastest T20I half-century by an Indian, reaching his fifty in just 14 balls against New Zealand. The explosive opener remained unbeaten on 68 off 20 deliveries, guiding India to an eight-wicket victory. Sharma attributed his fearless approach to team expectations and instinct.
title: ‘You never know’: Abhishek Sharma flirts with Yuvraj’s iconic record after blazing knock

author: TOI BUSINESS EXPERTS
description: Budget 2026: Last year’s Budget delivered meaningful tax relief through revisions in personal income-tax slabs and enhancement of the Section 87A rebate.
title: Budget 2026 income tax expectations: What can FM do for the next phase of tax simplification?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Venezuelan interim president Delcy Rodriguez said her government would take up long-standing disputes with Washington “face to face” through what she termed Bolivarian diplomacy, according to Xinhua news agency. She said Venezuela had never imagined that a South American capital would be subjected to a military attack by a foreign power, referring to the events of January 3, when US forces attacked Caracas and forcibly took away Maduro and his wife.
title: ‘Enough orders from Washington’: Venezuela interim leader amid pressure from US

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A ferry carrying over 350 people sank off the southern Philippines, resulting in at least 15 fatalities. Over 300 individuals were rescued following a distress call from a coast guard officer on board. Investigations are underway to determine the cause of the sinking, which occurred in good weather conditions.
title: Ferry carrying 350 passengers sinks off southern Philippines, at least 15 dead

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Harbhajan Singh criticized Pakistan's stance on Bangladesh's T20 World Cup exclusion, calling it an unnecessary attempt to create a '2 vs 1' scenario. He argued that Pakistan's intervention was uncalled for, as Bangladesh and its players are the ones suffering the most. Harbhajan also suggested the BCB let ego guide its decisions, hindering potential resolutions.
title: 'Fishing in muddy waters': Harbhajan slams Pakistan over Bangladesh T20 WC row

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: India celebrates its 77th Republic Day with a grand parade on Kartavya Path, showcasing military might and cultural diversity. European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen and European Council president António Costa are this years chief guests, highlighting a deepening strategic partnership. Discussions on a crucial free trade agreement and a new security pact are underway, underscoring strong India-EU ties.
title: India marks 77th republic day: Who are this year’s chief guests?

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board has accepted the ICC's decision to replace them with Scotland in the T20 World Cup after the government refused to clear the team for travel to India due to security concerns. The BCB stated they cannot participate in the current fixture and will not pursue arbitration.
title: ‘Not going to challenge’: BCB accepts ICC call as Bangladesh bow out quietly of T20 WC

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Ahead of the Republic Day celebrations, security forces in Manipur have intensified intelligence-based combing, cordon and search operations across vulnerable and fringe areas, leading to the recovery of a large cache of arms, ammunition and explosives, and the arrest of individuals linked to extortion and banned outfits.
title: Republic Day alert in Manipur: Security forces recover arms cache, neutralise IEDs

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Indian stock and commodity markets were closed on January 26 for Republic Day, marking the second holiday of 2026. Trading will resume on January 27. A total of 16 market holidays are scheduled for 2026, including national and religious observances.
title: Stock market holiday: Are Sensex, Nifty open for trading on January 26?

author: CHETHAN KUMAR
description: Receiving the Ashok Chakra, India's premier peacetime military distinction, Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla perceives this honor as a shared tribute from a grateful nation. Overflowing with gratitude and a renewed determination, he pledged to push the boundaries of India's innovative space endeavors.
title: Ashok Chakra a collective blessing frompeople of India, says Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Sunny Deol's 'Border 2' is a massive box office success, crossing the Rs 100 crore mark within just three days of its release. The patriotic war-drama, directed by Anurag Singh, has shown remarkable growth, especially with a significant jump on Sunday. The film's impressive occupancy rates indicate strong audience engagement, promising further gains during the upcoming holiday period.
title: 'Border 2' box office collections Day 3

author: TNN
description: In a startling discovery, Nagaur police uncovered an enormous stockpile of nearly 10,000kg of ammonium nitrate along with various explosive materials at a secluded farmhouse. One person has been taken into custody following this significant find in Sarhad Harsaur village.
title: Rajasthan cops seize 10,000 kg of ammonium nitrate on Republic Day eve; 1 held

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: As India gears up for its 77th Republic Day in 2026, the nation celebrates its Constitution, the 'Rule Book' uniting 1.4 billion citizens.
title: 75+ Happy Republic Day messages, greetings, wishes and quotes for 2026

author: SANDEEP MOUDGAL
description: In a bold move, the Karnataka government has earmarked a staggering 255 crore rupees in Bengaluru land for 22 Dalit and OBC mutts, dismissing departmental warnings regarding the allocation of protected gomala land within the city. Senior ministers brushed aside concerns raised by the finance and law departments about potential legal implications, asserting these were mere procedural hurdles.
title: Despite red flags, Karnataka grants Bengaluru land worth Rs 255 crore to 22 Dalit & OBC mutts

author: AMISHA PANDEY
description: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye's heartwarming pre-game kiss with his wife, Ann Michael, before the AFC Championship game has captivated fans. Their long-standing relationship, dating back to middle school, adds a romantic touch to their NFL journey. Ann Michael's own social media popularity further endears the couple to the public, highlighting a sweet blend of sports and personal connection.
title: Drake Maye steals hearts with pregame gesture for wife Ann Michael

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: ‘Wake-up call for America’: Obamas condemn killing of Alex Pretti

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: A European military analysis reveals India achieved air superiority during Operation Sindoor. This 88-hour operation in May 2025 forced Pakistan to seek a ceasefire. The report highlights the effectiveness of India's integrated air defence system. It also notes the loss of an Indian Rafale fighter jet. The conflict involved advanced aircraft and sophisticated air defence networks.
title: India's air superiority during Op Sindoor made Pak call for truce: European military analysis

author: AHSAN TASNIM
description: A 23-year-old Hindu mechanic, Chanchal Chandra Bhowmik, was tragically burnt alive in his Narsingdi workshop after it was deliberately set ablaze while he slept. Despite assurances of minority protection, this planned arson, captured on CCTV, saw Chanchal trapped and unable to escape the flames. Police are investigating and forming a team to apprehend the perpetrators.
title: Bangladesh: Hindu mechanic burnt to death in his workshop

author: JAIDEEP DEOGHARIA
description: A man jailed for eight years for his wife's murder has been acquitted. The court found critical flaws, including doubts about the recovered body's identity and a lack of established motive. The prosecution's case, built on circumstantial evidence, failed to form an unbroken chain pointing solely to the accused, leading to his immediate release.
title: Body found by cops not that of wife, man acquitted after 8 years

author: TNN
description: In a startling discovery, Nagaur police uncovered an enormous stockpile of nearly 10,000kg of ammonium nitrate along with various explosive materials at a secluded farmhouse. One person has been taken into custody following this significant find in Sarhad Harsaur village.
title: Rajasthan cops seize 10k-kg ammonium nitrate, other explosive material; 1 held

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Bangladesh cricket officials are considering a return for former captain Shakib Al Hasan, less than a year after his international retirement. This comes as the board also grapples with the team's exclusion from the T20 World Cup due to security concerns in India. Shakib, who had faced public anger, expressed openness to reversing his decision.
title: 'Will consider if ... ': BCB gives Hasina-linked cricketer ultimate selection conditions
